study type: secondary data analysis, cross-sectional, spatial and multilevel analysis
cohort: The study included 5,527 weighted samples of mothers from the 2019 Ethiopian mini demographic and health survey.
finding: The prevalence of CS delivery in Ethiopia was 5.4% with distinct geospatial variation, being concentrated in urban areas and parts of the Somali and Oromia regions, and associated with maternal age, education, household head gender, religion, multiple births, and region of residence.
mod_finding: The prevalence of CS delivery was 5.4% in Ethiopia, showing distinct geospatial variation and being associated with maternal age, education, household head gender, religion, multiple births, and region of residence.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2019 Ethiopian mini demographic and health survey
